text.p: Health Management Associates Inc said Tuesday Joseph V. Vumbacco, 51, has been promoted to president and chief operating officer, succeeding William J. Schoen, who will continue as chairman and chief executive officer.
Schoen said Vumbacco has demonstrated his leadership ability at Health Management and at previous assignments which included working for Schoen at the F & M Schaefer Corp.
Vumbacco joined Health Management Associates in January 1996 as executive vice president and a corporate officer.

The company also said Earl P. Holland, 52, another executive vice president has been promoted to vice chairman, a new position created by the company's rapid growth and its excellent future opportunities.
